units.source_text: 妇女们不甚懂得鹰猎之事，只因难得见到，而且光景好看，所以争先恐后地观赏。

en.t: The women did not know much about falconry, but because it was a rare sight and the scene was so splendid, they all hurried to watch it.

units.source_text: 其中也有身份微不足道的人，乘着蹩脚的车子，半路上车轮损坏了，正在周章狼狈。

en.t: Among them were people of very low rank, riding in shabby carriages whose wheels had broken on the way, leaving them flustered and helpless.

units.source_text: 桂川上的浮桥旁边，也有许多风流潇洒的高贵女车，正在徬徨着找寻停车之处。

en.t: Beside the floating bridge over the Katsura River, many elegant and noble ladies' carriages were also wandering about, searching for a place to stop.
